名指しした担当者は現れず、他の洋名の人が対応。ただ、なんとなくそれぞれ偽名を使っていそうな感じ。また、この回も一方的に不正をしたと決め付けられチャットも閉じられた。

reviews.title: Formal Complaint Regarding the Unacceptable Targeting and Suppression of Saudi Accounts in TikTok
reviews.text:
TikTok's continued and seemingly biased enforcement against Saudi accounts and comments is absolutely unacceptable and demands immediate attention.
How can TikTok justify allowing offensive attacks, insults, and harmful comments directed at Saudi Arabia and its people to remain on the platform, while comments defending Saudi Arabia are restricted, removed, or penalized? Applying community guidelines selectively is a serious failure of fairness, consistency, and credibility.
Saudi users deserve the same rights, protections, and freedom to express their opinions and defend their country as every other user on this platform. Defending one's country against insults and misinformation should not be treated as a violation while the original attacks are allowed to continue.If TikTok claims to enforce its policies fairly, then those policies must apply equally to everyone, regardless of nationality.
• An immediate review of moderation decisions affecting Saudi accounts and comments
• A transparent explanation of why defensive comments are penalized while offensive comments targeting Saudi Arabia appear to be tolerated
• The restoration of accounts and comments that were unfairly restricted or removed
• Concistent and imnartial enforcement of community guidelines without nationality-based discrimination
Let this be absolutely clear: Saudi users will not accept a platform that appears to silence them when they defend themselves while giving offensive content against their country room

reviews.title: Stop with the unrelated ads spamming
reviews.text:
I find myself opening Instagram Reels more often simply because it has far fewer ads. Sure, Instagram has the occasional sponsored post, but it’s nowhere near as disruptive as TikTok.

Whenever I search for something on TikTok, the very next swipe often turns into a completely unrelated sponsored video. For example, if I’m researching the LSKD running belt, instead of showing me LSKD running belts or reviews, I get ads for protein powder. I DON’T WANT protein ads!!!!! I want content related to what I actually searched for, show me what I want to seee.

It took multiple attempts of blocking creators and marking ads as “Not Interested” just to get my search results back on track. That’s a terrible user experience when I’m trying to research a product.

TikTok, please improve your search ad targeting. If someone is actively searching for a topic, don’t immediately interrupt that experience with irrelevant ads. DO BETTER.

같은날 같이 깔았는데 한사람은 출석만 해도 4천원같은 높은 금액이고 한사람은 출석 14일 연속해도 140포인트고 매일광고 40개를 봐야만 금액을 받을수있는데, 이젠 그 40개 마져도 3개 보고 10분 쉬어야하고 
동일하게 해야하는거 아닌가요?
매우 불만족입니다
